backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no methods.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping a bilingual landing‑page update to affected frontend files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing each major frontend landing component and styling files.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root component rendering Header, Hero, Services, AreasServed, and Footer.
frontend/src/components/landing/AreasSer: Bilingual areas-served section listing service locations and a call CTA.
frontend/src/components/landing/Footer.t: Bilingual footer with brand info, quick links, contact details, and CTA buttons.
frontend/src/components/landing/Header.t: Sticky bilingual header with logo, navigation, and call/WhatsApp CTAs.
frontend/src/components/landing/Hero.tsx: Hero section with background image, bilingual headlines, and call/WhatsApp buttons.
frontend/src/components/landing/Services: Service cards for four offerings with bilingual titles, descriptions, and pricing.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook creating and updating a backend actor based on Internet Identity authentication.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for managing Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, and identity loading. Wraps AuthClient with configurable options and exposes status flags.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base layers and custom OKLCH color variables for light/dark themes, plus utility helpers for text balance and bilingual readability.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with React Query and the InternetIdentityProvider before rendering App.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors mapped to CSS variables, extended utilities, typography and animation plugins, and container settings.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata, requirements, known issues, and feature definitions for the bilingual sofa-cleaning marketing website.
